verdict.rationale: Codegen documents that its agent can review PRs, suggest changes and comment ([codegen-docs-4]), and can be told to "Leave a review on PR #123" via the SDK ([codegen-docs-15]). A described workflow reads the PR diff and posts a review comment on failure ([codegen-docs-20]). However, the evidence points to prompt-, mention- or failure-triggered reviews ([codegen-docs-23], [codegen-docs-18]) rather than automatic review of every PR, and line-level inline comments are never shown. Missing for 10: documented automatic review on every PR, explicit inline (line-level) review comments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
